A food item which restores {{Energy||10 -}} {{Energy||20}} and applies the beer thirst buff when consumed. It can be made in the [[oven]]. The quality is dependent on the ingredients used as well as any [[perks]] or [[sermons]] that might be active.  Higher quality {{PAGENAME}} have a larger restorative effect when consumed. The recipe can be unlocked by talking to [[Horadric]] while carrying {{item|onion||copper}} (one is enough and must be {{Quality|Copper}}.) in your inventory. For the main page on preparing food see [[cooking]].

==Effect==

On use, onion rings will apply the beer thirst buff for a duration of 2 minutes. The buff increases energy restoration from [[a mug of beer|beer]] by 33%. For a list of buffs see the [[Effects]] page.
